mutation_types.name: OFF_BY_ONE
mutation_types.description: Modify range() bounds or comparison constants by ±1

mutation_types.name: CONSTANT_MUTATION
mutation_types.description: Perturb integer constants by ±1/2, or append suffix to strings

mutation_types.name: BOUNDARY_CONDITION
mutation_types.description: Remove a guard check (if x < 0: return None) by replacing body with Pass

mutation_types.name: CONDITION_NEGATE
mutation_types.description: Negate an If branch condition with not()

mutation_types.name: RETURN_MUTATION
mutation_types.description: Alter a return value: add 1 to ints, negate booleans/expressions

mutation_types.name: EXCEPTION_SUPPRESSION
mutation_types.description: Replace except handler body with pass, swallowing the exception

mutation_types.name: LOOP_BOUND_CHANGE
mutation_types.description: Modify range() start/stop to skip first or last iteration

mutation_types.name: MISSING_UPDATE
mutation_types.description: Remove an AugAssign (+=/-=) inside a loop body

mutation_types.name: WRONG_VARIABLE
mutation_types.description: Substitute one local variable name for another in a single Load site

mutation_types.name: CONDITION_REMOVAL
mutation_types.description: Remove an if-check entirely; inline its body unconditionally

mutation_types.name: STATE_TRANSITION_ERROR
mutation_types.description: Change a target state constant to a different state constant
